title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Number C40: Gimmick Puppet of Dark Strings LDS3-EN065
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This is a highly sought-after Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card, featuring the Gimmick Puppet of Dark Strings design. It is part of the Legendary Duelists: Season 3 set, with an ultra-rare rarity and English language. The card is an effect type, with a card number of LDS3-EN065, and it has 2000 defense/toughness and 3300 attack/power. 

This card is perfect for any collector or player of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG, and it comes in 1st edition. The manufacturer of the card is Konami, and it is a great addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this amazing card!
